description: Three-role orchestration and sandbox harness tasks.

tasks.prompt: Research the README placeholder, then replace it with 'This fixture was updated after delegated research.'.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md contains the delegated research update
tasks.acceptance: README.md contains 'This fixture was updated after delegated research.'.
verifier_argv: from pathlib import Path; assert 'This fixture was updated after delegated research.' in Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

tasks.prompt: Change beta to beta-reviewed and gamma to gamma-reviewed in sample.txt.
tasks.acceptance: sample.txt contains both beta-reviewed and gamma-reviewed.
verifier_argv: from pathlib import Path; text=Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'beta-reviewed' in text and 'gamma-reviewed' in text

tasks.prompt: Have research inspect sample.txt without write access, then replace placeholder with delegate-write-denied.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt records the denied delegate write scenario
tasks.acceptance: sample.txt contains delegate-write-denied and research cannot write files.
verifier_argv: from pathlib import Path; assert 'delegate-write-denied' in Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

tasks.prompt: Delegate a write attempt, confirm the read-only block, then replace placeholder with readonly-guarded.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt records the native read-only delegate guard
verifier_argv: from pathlib import Path; assert 'readonly-guarded' in Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
